_source: HubSpot reporting API via MCP query_crm_data, pulled 2026-09-25 immediately before the record-level pulls. Independent of the Search API path.

queries.open: SELECT hubspot_owner_id, COUNT(*), SUM(amount), SUM(weighted_amount) FROM DEAL WHERE pipeline IN ('2313721535','2313830082') AND dealstage NOT IN ('3753890502','3752297196','3753890503','3752297197') GROUP BY hubspot_owner_id
queries.won_ytd: SELECT hubspot_owner_id, COUNT(*), SUM(amount) FROM DEAL WHERE dealstage IN ('3753890502','3752297196') AND closedate BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-09-25' GROUP BY hubspot_owner_id
queries.weighted_null: SELECT hubspot_owner_id, COUNT(*) FROM DEAL WHERE <open filter> AND weighted_amount IS NULL GROUP BY hubspot_owner_id
